result:
This all looks correct and complete.

## Summary

**`src/hooks/useStyleStore.ts`** — Added an explicit `hasUnsavedChanges` boolean state, set `true` synchronously in `change()` (the single mutation entry point), cleared `false` only in the save effect's existing success branch (same `captured === latestGeneration.current` guard the status text already uses), and set `true` again on save failure and in `retrySave()`. Exposed on the returned store. Never inferred from the `status` string.

**`src/components/AccountDialog.tsx`** — New `hasUnsavedChanges` / `onExportBackup` props. Saved wardrobe: unchanged simple "Sign out" (now also checks `signOut()`'s error result, `busy`-gated). Unsaved: plain "Sign out" is not rendered at all; instead shows explicit wording, an "Export draft" button wired to the real export flow, and a two-step "Discard unsaved changes and sign out…" → "Discard and sign out" / "Cancel" confirmation before any `authClient.signOut()` call. Delete-account flow also now checks `signOut()`'s error result.

**`src/app/page.tsx`** — Passes `store.hasUnsavedChanges` / `store.exportBackup` into `AccountDialog`; added a `beforeunload` listener (installed/removed via effect cleanup) only while changes are unsaved, justified by the same risk the sign-out guard addresses.

**`tests/e2e/consumer.spec.ts`** — New test: delays then fails `PUT /api/wardrobe`, confirms the footer shows the failed-save state, opens the account dialog, asserts no plain "Sign out" button exists, exercises "Export draft" (real download), then the two-step discard-and-sign-out path, ending back at the sign-in screen. Scoped all dialog assertions via `getByRole("dialog", ...)` to avoid colliding with the identically-labelled button in the page's own error banner. No existing tests were changed.

**`scripts/restore-database.ts`** — Reviewed the checkpoint-before-sidecar-deletion ordering; it's already correct (checkpoint → close → copy/validate staging → delete live sidecars → atomic rename), so no change was made.

**`src/server/database.ts`** — Confirmed unchanged: `journal_mode = WAL` still runs inside `runReady()` under the `proper-lockfile` mutex.

**`docs/reviews/implementation-004-notes.md`** — Written with full detail for Codex to test against.

For Codex: run build/type/lint, the full Playwright suite (new test is additive, doesn't touch others), and manually verify the two-step discard flow and `beforeunload` prompt in a browser.
